title: Fix SchemaRendererProvider missing in object-view stories
body:
Storybook CI failing with `useSchemaContext must be used within a SchemaRendererProvider` error for object-view stories.

## Changes

- Import `SchemaRendererProvider` from `@object-ui/react` (aligns with other story files)
- Wrap `SchemaRenderer` with provider in `renderStory` function

```diff
-import { SchemaRenderer } from '../SchemaRenderer';
+import { SchemaRenderer, SchemaRendererProvider } from '@object-ui/react';

-const renderStory = (args: any) => <SchemaRenderer schema={args as unknown as BaseSchema} />;
+const renderStory = (args: any) => (
+  <SchemaRendererProvider dataSource={{}}>
+    <SchemaRenderer schema={args as unknown as BaseSchema} />
+  </SchemaRendererProvider>
+);
```

Components using `useSchemaContext` hook require the provider context. Pattern matches `object-grid.stories.tsx` and `page.stories.tsx`.
